newsitem.title: USA: Viking Office hit after Q3 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Viking Office hit after Q3 forecast.

text.p: Shares of Viking Office Products Inc tumbled in heavy trading early Tuesday after the company forecast fiscal third quarter earnings below Wall Street expectations.

Shares fell nearly 30 percent, down 5-1/2 to 14-1/2, a level not seen since June 1995. The stock was the most heavily traded issue on the Nasdaq with nearly 2.5 million shares changing hands by 0950 EDT/1350 GMT.
Viking said earnings in the third quarter, ended March 31, would be affected by slow growth in Britain and France, a stronger dollar, and lower paper pricing.
The company said third quarter earnings per share should grow 15 percent from a year earlier. That would take earnings to about $0.2415 from $0.21 a year ago.
Analysts expect $0.27 a share from the Los Angeles company, according to First Call.
Viking said third-quarter revenues will be up about 15 percent, and net income as a percentage of revenues is expected at about 5.8 percent.
No one at Viking was available for comment. Earlier today the company said it would hold a conference call on April 9 at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT.
